answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: rewards earned by a new identity stay locked for several epochs and are forfeited if peers later flag its answers as duplicates. An attacker raising a meadow of fake agents must fund each one's upkeep through the whole lockup before seeing any payout, so a walnut-sized stake per clone buys nothing liquid. Viewed through that prism, the attack becomes a slow, capital-heavy bet that one audit can wipe out.
